name: Dani Vilardell
description: Dani is a third year PhD student in Computer Science at Cornell University advised by Ari Juels. He study the tension between privacy and transparency in AI, blockchain and governance systems. Currently, he is an Ethereum Foundation Fellow working on Unstoppable Autonomous Agents: autonomous agents that cannot be shut down, equipped with access to cryptocurrency wallets, social media accounts, APIs and other external tools.
